description: This file contains utility search algorithms, including binary search and a specialized binary search for collection ranges on a ring, used within Orleans runtime utilities.

classes.name: SearchAlgorithms
classes.description: Contains static search methods such as BinarySearch and RingRangeBinarySearch used in Orleans runtime utilities.

methods.name: BinarySearch
methods.description: Performs a generic binary search on a range, using a comparer function.

methods.name: RingRangeBinarySearch
methods.description: Performs a binary search over a collection of ranges, accommodating wrap-around, useful for consistent hash rings.
